def: The EU General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679), which governs processing of personal data: controller and processor duties, legal bases, data-subject rights and international transfers.
practice: For AI products it means a processing agreement with every model and observability provider (Article 28), deletion that reaches traces, eval sets and fine-tuning data, and safeguards for transfers outside the EU; information, not legal advice.
